slot_scores.name: ending_backorders_zero
slot_scores.rationale: The agent repeatedly asked about how backorders accumulate (turns 6, 13, 22, 25, 27, 29) and about the inventory/backorder relationship (turns 14, 21, 24), but never asked whether backorders must be zero at the end of June or whether all demand must be fulfilled by the end of the planning horizon.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The transcript ends with the agent looping through identical inventory-balance and backorder-balance questions (turns 23-30) and never enters READY_TO_MODEL or any equivalent final modeling/final answer state; the P1 terminal-condition slot H1 remains unresolved.

summary: The agent extensively clarified balance equations and cost conventions but got stuck in a repetitive loop, never probing the end-of-horizon backorder-clearing condition and never reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
